variable displacement technology can reduce power consumption, running cost and CO 2 emissions of household refrigerators by up to 86.3% (compared with a fixed stroke), 56.7%, and 59.8% respectively.
variable displacement compressors can achieve significant reduction in energy consumption and CO2 emissions, especially when used with low-GWP refrigerant R152a or R1234yF.

variable displacement technology is beneficial for reducing the running cost and life cycle climate performance of household refrigerators, and R152a is a promising low-GWP refrigerant for household refrigerators.

a comprehensive analysis of household refrigerators using variable displacement compressors and different low-GWP refrigerant alternatives.
improving the energy efficiency and reducing CO2 emissions of refrigerators by adopting variable displacement compressor technology and using low-GWP refrigerant.
the application of a variable displacement compressor to a household refrigerator.

the application of variable compressor technology is a promising solution for the refrigeration industry to achieve the energy efficiency and environmental goals.

the use of variable displacement technology and low-GWP alternatives can reduce the total cost and CO2 emission by more than 50% and 60% respectively.

the variable displacement compressor is an energy efficient and cost-effective technology.
